name: io.github.justrouting/justrouting
title: JustRouting MCP Server
description: Road routing, travel-time matrices, geocoding, and fleet optimization for Southeast Asia.

tools.name: route
tools.description: Calculate a driving or motorcycle route between two locations - distance, travel duration, route geometry, snapped endpoints and main roads

tools.name: geocode
tools.description: Convert a place name or address into coordinates

tools.name: table
tools.description: Compute a matrix of travel durations and distances between many locations at once

tools.name: optimize
tools.description: Solve vehicle routing problems - assign jobs to vehicles and order each vehicle's stops

environmentVariables.name: JUSTROUTING_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your JustRouting API key (create one at https://justrouting.tech)
